rooms.name: Puja room
rooms.note: Small. Tight rooms are the hard case at the photo tier: the camera cannot back far enough away to frame a whole wall, so every view is oblique and close.

topology.cycle_note: The only cycle in the property is Living room to Hall and back, through archways A and B. Every other room hangs off the Hall by a single edge, and a single edge cannot contradict itself. That one cycle is the property's only means of catching its own stitching error.

open_questions: Bathrooms are not listed. A three-bedroom home has at least one; do they open off the Hall or off the bedrooms? They matter beyond topology: the brief requires mirrors, glass and wet-look surfaces to be covered, and a bathroom is where all three occur at once.
Is there a main entrance door onto the Hall? It would raise the Hall's opening count and it is an opening the pipeline must detect like any other.

Which opening type connects the Hall to each bedroom, the kitchen and the puja room - hinged door or open archway? Only archways give the photo tier a through-view, so this decides which adjacencies are recoverable at that tier and which are not.
